properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 live uses: Electrum ABC x509 certificate fingerprints (x509.py:407) and RSA key fingerprints (rsakey.py:43/347); the node's Qt BIP70 payment-request verification selects EVP_sha1 as digest algorithm (paymentrequestplus.cpp:72); crypto_hash.cpp benchmarks the node's own SHA-1 implementation; a functional test hashes with hashlib.sha1; Cargo.lock ships a SHA-1 implementation as a dependency. SHA-1 is collision-broken; fingerprints are cosmetic but the BIP70 digest path is security-relevant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (JS implementations of SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD/MD5 family) declared in pnpm-lock.yaml, typically pulled in by elliptic for the web wallet's EC crypto. Confirms hash primitives available in the shipped JS tree; SHA-1 members are collision-broken.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: the md5 npm package (MD5 hashing, collision-broken and quantum-unsafe) is declared in the web apps' lockfile. md5@2.3.0 sits in the pnpm dependency tree of the monorepo's web apps; MD5 anywhere in the tree is a defect to replace with SHA-256+.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The blockchain's signature curve — the entire eCash stack is built on secp256k1 ECDSA/Schnorr: the vendored libsecp256k1 in src/secp256k1 (shipped in every Dockerfile), Rust bindings modules/ecash-secp256k1, Electrum ABC's ecc.py/schnorr.py, tiny-secp256k1@2.2.3 in apps/token-server. Classical signature, migrate on schedule to ML-DSA-65 (deadline risk, not HNDL). Some of the 5992 sites are prose/CI references to the secp256k1 repo, but the object itself is the codebase's core signature curve, us

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two real assets: (1) bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (bcrypt-based KDF) declared 3× in pnpm-lock.yaml — shipped JS dependency; (2) contrib/guix/symbol-check.py allowlists bcrypt.dll as an expected import of the shipped Windows binaries — the platform bcrypt crypto provider is linked into release builds (governance/build assertion).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC (unauthenticated) in Electrum ABC: crypto.py implements the wallet's password-encryption path; the fusion plugin encrypt.py encrypts/decrypts CashFusion pool rounds with AES-CBC + SHA-256 derived keys. Live call chains confirmed by AST. Changeable here — the fusion protocol design also fixes CBC for cross-client compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live wallet-encryption KDFs with iteration counts far below OWASP minimums (600k): Electrum ABC derives its wallet-storage key with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 1024 iterations and an EMPTY salt (storage.py:186); the node's legacy wallet crypter defaults nDeriveIterations=25000 (crypter.h:51, wallet.cpp:560, wallet.cpp:814). These protect real wallet funds on disk — the most exploitable finding class here (CWE-916).

properties.name: pqs:context

Governance artifact — this doc is the template deployers copy; observable here, fixable in the doc.
